up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725984'. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and the preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name). Use the docs table to locate the document by its chembl_id, then join compound_records on doc_id, then join molecule_dictionary on molregno. Include all molecules without any row limit.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725984' ORDER BY md.pref_name;
